XMLDB.COMMENT: XMLDB file for the local_aimedia plugin.

TABLE.NAME: local_aimedia_transcript
TABLE.COMMENT: What each transcription request produced. The recording itself is not kept here: it is identified by its content hash, so the same recording asked about twice is recognisable without this table holding a copy of somebody's voice.

FIELD.NAME: contenthash
FIELD.COMMENT: The content hash of the recording that was sent.

FIELD.NAME: filename
FIELD.COMMENT: What the recording was called, so that a person can recognise their own.

FIELD.NAME: filesize
FIELD.COMMENT: How large the recording was, in bytes.

FIELD.NAME: language
FIELD.COMMENT: The language the request named. Null where the model was left to work it out, which is not the same as an empty language.

FIELD.NAME: durationms
FIELD.COMMENT: How long the recording was, in milliseconds, where the provider said.

FIELD.NAME: userid
FIELD.COMMENT: Who asked. Held here rather than only in core's action register, so that a request to export or forget this row does not depend on which privacy provider runs first.

TABLE.NAME: local_aimedia_describe
TABLE.COMMENT: What each question about a picture produced. The picture itself is not kept: it is identified by its content hash.

FIELD.NAME: prompt
FIELD.COMMENT: What was asked about the picture.

FIELD.NAME: contenthash
FIELD.COMMENT: The content hash of the picture that was sent.

FIELD.NAME: filesize
FIELD.COMMENT: How large the picture was, in bytes.

FIELD.NAME: prompttokens
FIELD.COMMENT: Tokens the question and the picture came to.

FIELD.NAME: userid
FIELD.COMMENT: Who asked. Held here rather than only in core's action register, so that a request to export or forget this row does not depend on which privacy provider runs first.
